name: Send daily watchlist news digests by email using AlphAI

parameters.content:
## Send daily watchlist news digests by email using AlphAI

### How it works

1. A Schedule Trigger runs the workflow once a day at 8am.
2. A Code node defines the watchlist and emits one item per ticker.
3. An HTTP Request node fetches high relevance news (score 7 or higher) for each ticker from the AlphAI news API, with sentiment and category already attached.
4. A Code node dedupes across days, groups articles by ticker and builds one clean HTML digest linking every item to the full analysis on alphai.io.
5. An email node sends the digest over SMTP.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Create a free AlphAI API key at alphai.io (Account, API keys).
- [ ] On the "Fetch Ticker News" node, add a Bearer Auth credential and paste the key without the "Bearer " prefix.
- [ ] Edit the tickers array in the "Define Watchlist Tickers" node.
- [ ] On the "Send Digest Email" node, create an SMTP credential and set the from and to addresses.
- [ ] Activate the workflow.

### Customization

Change the schedule time, the tickers or the relevance floor. To preview without sending, execute "Build Digest Email" and inspect its HTML output.

## Set schedule and watchlist

Runs once a day and defines the tickers to digest. US tickers are bare, crypto uses BTC-USD, foreign uses the Yahoo suffix.

## Fetch ticker news

Calls the AlphAI news API once per ticker and returns scored articles with sentiment and category attached.

## Build and send the digest

Dedupes across days, groups articles by ticker and emails one clean HTML digest over SMTP.
